title: Imee flags retirement benefits provision in Ombudsman budget
summary: Sen. Imee Marcos flagged a provision in the 2027 proposed budget for the Office of the Ombudsman to allow the ombudsman, the deputy ombudsman, and the special prosecutor to qualify for retirement…

blocks.text: Sen. Imee Marcos flagged a provision in the 2027 proposed budget for the Office of the Ombudsman to allow the ombudsman, the deputy ombudsman, and the special prosecutor to qualify for retirement benefits even if they do not complete their seven-year terms.
